title: The castle courtyard
alt: A crowded castle courtyard with displays, banners, a shield, map, crown, lantern and Cbear in his navy scarf under the stone arch.

finds.label: Blue shield
finds.spoken: Find the blue shield under the arch.

finds.label: Gold key
finds.spoken: Find the gold key on the table at the front.

finds.label: Map
finds.spoken: Find the map on the stand under the arch.

finds.label: Lantern
finds.spoken: Find the lantern hanging at the top right.

finds.label: Crown
finds.spoken: Find the crown in the glass case.

sounds.text: Listen for m in map. Look by the map.
sounds.spoken: Listen for the m sound in map. Look by the map.

words.text: Look by the map. Sound out map.
